The pass preserves the required defaults and controls, corrects the track, car, and brick dimensions, and scales the cameras and shadow frustum with track length. It also keeps collision handling outside Rapier’s event callback, snapshots glass state before removal, gives wheels breakable axle hinges, makes shard physics deterministic across replays, and reduces static draw calls and replay resource buildup.
